title: Hourly Trump-Netanyahu Auto-Dig:municipal record access and current diplomacy

sources.title: Kushner's talks with Israel, Hamas end without breakthrough on Trump Gaza plan

data.research_question: What current official access surfaces advance the queued Netanya/Ashkelon historical-project target, and what materially new current news belongs in the existing Trump-Netanyahu topic?
data.method: Enumerated 27 physical digs roots on current main 1ced5ee5b386283498389d6bc6e34f95178bda7d. Excluded free-range as the meta-root and the previous three successful hourly roots cia, wef-columbus and hunter-biden, leaving 23 eligible roots:canada-policy-influence, cloarida, dark-academia, devil-corp, dnc, drunk-drivers, fed, flock, gop, graphika, greater-israel, larry-fink, lexisnexis-risk-state-surveillance, occrp-aleph, offshore-leaks, palantir, tech-bro, trump-netanyahu, trump-thiel-circle, us-israel-military-integration, usaid-doge-mortality-accountability, violent-offenders, wef. Dataset seed 8846859080470936735 selected trump-netanyahu at the dataset stage. The selected packet exposed four queued canonical investigation targets; target seed 11464156926912181441 selected starintel:investigation-target:netanya-ashkelon-municipal-land-records. The HQ/location phase mapped current Netanya engineering and tenders offices and Ashkelon official record-request mechanisms without inventing headquarters semantics. The news phase ingested the August 17 Kushner-Netanyahu Gaza-plan talks as a separate diplomatic event.
classification_rules: departmental public office is not headquarters
request surface is not evidence that a particular historical file exists
current diplomatic negotiation is not a commercial joint venture
failure to find an indexed official file is not proof of absence

findings.finding: Netanya's current official directory identifies engineering and tenders offices useful for the historical project-record search.
Ashkelon exposes official building-file and freedom-of-information request mechanisms.
Exact historical Netanya/Ashkelon project file identifiers remain unresolved.
Reuters reported August 17 Kushner-Netanyahu talks on the Trump Gaza plan ending without a breakthrough while working groups were established.
